title: Publish the OpenAPI contract
acceptance:
Story: the 0.2 client and every agent build against a written contract.
Expected: an openapi.yaml beside the server copy documents every operation, the bearer scheme and the error shape, and CI reads it, calls every documented operation and validates every documented response status.
Not expected: generated client code or a public developer portal.
Depends on: the routes from WI-12 to WI-16.
Verify: the contract suite reads openapi.yaml and exercises every documented operation and response status.
evidence: openapi.yaml documents all 12 operations, the bearer scheme and the error shape. The 26 November review found the old proof never read the published file; WI-23 adds openapi.test.mjs, which parses openapi.yaml, calls every operation, validates all 40 documented response statuses against their schemas, asserts set equality and PATCH 405, and fails on an undocumented status or a dropped section. CI runs it beside the server suite. PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
